label.description: v0.8, `any_of` only: Spanish display name of the compound, e.g. 'Noche larga', from an Atlas config keyed by `term` (configs/compound_terms.json); display only, so names can change without refitting.
label.title: Label

label_en.description: v0.8, `any_of` only: English display name of the compound, e.g. 'Long night'.
label_en.title: Label En

modifier.description: Hedge exponent applied to the membership, if any.
modifier.title: Modifier

operator.description: v0.8: `is` one term; `at_least` / `at_most` a term of the ordered terms of a quantity input ('x is at least Fair'); `any_of` a named compound of terms (a stretch of the clock or the week). The membership of the last three is the bounded sum min(1, sum of the memberships of `terms`) (ex_fuzzy).
operator.title: Operator

term.description: The term the condition refers to: for `is` the term itself, for `at_least` / `at_most` the threshold term (the lowest / the highest term covered), for `any_of` the compound's internal name (the key of `label`), which is not a term of the variable.
term.title: Term

terms.description: v0.8: names of the base terms of the variable that the condition covers, in the variable's order (low to high). A compound may cover non-adjacent terms: the first and the last term of a clock are the two ends of one stretch of the day that wraps midnight. `[term]` for `is`; filled in when absent.
terms.title: Terms

allow_unknown.description: Classifier only: no class when no rule fires.
allow_unknown.title: Allow Unknown

fallback.description: Output when no rule fires. 'largest_bias' (v0.7, rule mixture without allow_unknown): the class of the largest class_bias.
fallback.title: Fallback

mixture_C.description: v0.7, rule mixture only: inverse strength of the L2 penalty ||W||^2 / 2 of the multinomial logistic fit of the weights on the firing strengths of the fitting rows (scikit-learn's C).
mixture_C.title: Mixture C

mixture_weights.description: v0.7, rule mixture only: how the class weights were fitted. Both describe the same family of decision functions (adding a constant to all the class weights of one rule changes no prediction); only the L2 penalty differs. Compare rules with RuleDefinition.class_weights_centred.
mixture_weights.title: Mixture Weights

rule_mode.description: TSK/Mamdani only: how many rules take part.

rule_weighting.description: Winning-rule classifier only: association degree = firing x this rule weight (ex_fuzzy ds_mode).
rule_weighting.title: Rule Weighting

label.description: v0.5.1: display name of the term, e.g. '≤ límite de detección' for '<=L'; the UI shows it instead of `name`, which stays the key that rules refer to.
label.title: Label

label_en.description: v0.6: English display name of the term, e.g. '≤ detection limit'; the UI shows it when the interface is in English, else falls back to `label` (then `name`).
label_en.title: Label En

params.description: ex_fuzzy semantics: trapezoidal and triangular are both [a, b, c, d] (trapezoid form); gaussian is [mean, std] with mu = exp(-((x - mean) / std) ** 2), no 1/2 factor.
params.title: Params

description.description: v0.5: what the input is and when it is known relative to the issue time.
description.title: Description

description_en.description: v0.6: English version of `description`; the UI shows it when the interface is in English, else falls back to `description`.
description_en.title: Description En

domain.description: Universe of discourse. ex_fuzzy clips inputs to it: values outside get the edge membership.
domain.title: Domain

label.description: v0.5: display name of the input, e.g. 'NO₂ hace 3 h'; the UI shows it instead of `feature`.
label.title: Label

label_en.description: v0.6: English display name of the input, e.g. 'NO₂ 4 h ago'; the UI shows it when the interface is in English, else falls back to `label` (then `feature`).
label_en.title: Label En

class_weights.description: v0.7, rule mixture only: W[r, c] for every class of target_scheme, as fitted. The rule adds W[r, c] x firing to the score of class c. Signed when mixture_weights is 'unconstrained'. A weight is a coefficient of a fitted linear model on firing strengths: not a probability, a confidence or a risk.
class_weights.title: Class Weights

class_weights_centred.description: v0.7, rule mixture only: class_weights minus their mean over the classes. Adding a constant to all the weights of one rule changes no prediction, so this is the form to read and to compare between non-negative and unconstrained fits: a positive value means the rule supports that class (raises its score relative to the other classes), a negative one that it suppresses it (lowers it relative to the others). Suppression is not 'evidence against' the class, and neither is a probability.
class_weights_centred.title: Class Weights Centred

consequent.description: What the rule concludes. Rule mixture (v0.7): the class the genetic search attached to the rule, used by the search and its pruning only; it does not enter the prediction (class_weights do), so it must not be shown as the rule's conclusion.

duplicate_of.description: rule_id of the first rule with identical antecedents; such rules always fire together.
duplicate_of.title: Duplicate Of

position.description: Index in the model's rule base.
position.title: Position

rule_id.description: Stable within one model_id only; R07 of another model is unrelated.
rule_id.title: Rule Id

strongest_class.description: v0.7, rule mixture only: the class with the largest weight (first in scheme order on ties); null when all its weights are equal (a duplicate rule, whose weights are all zero): such a rule changes no prediction.
strongest_class.title: Strongest Class

weight.description: Winning-rule classifier: weight multiplying the firing in the association degree.
weight.title: Weight

SchemeKind.description: What a classification scheme is (v0.4); the UI words the classes differently for each.
SchemeKind.title: SchemeKind

description_en.description: v0.6: English version of `description`; the UI shows it when the interface is in English, else falls back to `description`.
description_en.title: Description En

display_label.description: v0.5.1: name shown in the UI language when the official `label` is in another one, e.g. EAQI 'Good' -> 'Buena'. `label` stays the key and the official name.
display_label.title: Display Label

display_label_en.description: v0.6: English display name of the class, e.g. ICA 'Buena' -> 'Good' (EAQI: its own official name); the UI shows it when the interface is in English, else falls back to `display_label` (then `label`).
display_label_en.title: Display Label En

lower.description: Lower bound in the scheme unit; null = unbounded.
lower.title: Lower

merged_from.description: v0.4: labels of the official classes this one groups (e.g. ICA 'Desfavorable o peor').
merged_from.title: Merged From

upper.description: Upper bound in the scheme unit; null = unbounded.
upper.title: Upper

TargetScheme.description: Ordered categories of a classification target, taken from a cited source (e.g. an official index).

boundary.description: Which bound a value exactly on a boundary belongs to.
boundary.title: Boundary

kind.description: v0.4: official index, percentile reference or analytical.

name_en.description: v0.6: English display name of the scheme; the UI shows it when the interface is in English, else falls back to `name`.
name_en.title: Name En

short_name.description: v0.4: compact name for legends, e.g. 'ICA'.
short_name.title: Short Name

short_name_en.description: v0.6: English compact name, e.g. 'Relative level' for 'Nivel relativo'; the UI shows it when the interface is in English, else falls back to `short_name`.
short_name_en.title: Short Name En

TargetScheme.title: TargetScheme

class_bias.description: v0.7, rule mixture only: b_c for every class of target_scheme (centred to mean 0). The score of class c is b_c + sum over the rules of class_weights[c] x firing; it is the score of a row that fires no rule.
class_bias.title: Class Bias

synthetic.description: True for fixtures; the UI must label them as synthetic.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

target_scheme.description: Required for classifiers: the class labels.
